items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think Sonny Stitt would have blended in very musically... The only thing I heard about was that he and Sonny Stitt went to Santi Runyon... I think Gerry talked him out of that in terms of the balance that my sound would add to the ensemble.

ctx.x: Phil played well, I mean he always does, but it’s definitely not the original conception. You’re one of the players it’s really built around: you, Miles, and Mulligan’s baritone sound, the French horn, and Tuba. I think those are the most important components of the sound of that band.
I think Sonny Stitt would have blended in very musically but it would’ve still brought in another weight to his notes, I think.
